name: Panirugan Red Harbor Light
blurb: A Hangar-only red harbor marker with separate lit and unlit lenses; the red lens is flat review color, not emitted light.
history: The campaign plan calls for a red harbor light at Panirugan as a navigation reference. Its exact tower drawing was not recovered in F3, so the structure is an estimate grounded in the Philippine coast-pilot context.

sources.title: United States Coast Pilot, Philippine Islands
